story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: The 22nd of November 1998. I guess we’ll put a pin in it until further notice. Thank you, Frank Benjamin Foster. It’s been a education to me to have a chance to dialogue with you about your life and your career. Thank you.
My pleasure. ----------------------------------- [Transcribed by Barry Kernfeld from a digital copy of the tape reels]
